input.summary: Add mutual successor-assignment carve-out on written notice to the nonassignability clause
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a mutual carve-out allowing either party to assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets on written notice, leaving the existing consent standard (not to be unreasonably withheld) intact for all other assignments. This is our fallback position on assignment.

ops.text: The foregoing consent requirement shall not apply to an assignment of this Agreement by either party to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all of its assets, which may be made upon written notice to the other party.
